result.authority: the package owns one private random route, fixed marker-only request shape, fixed scripted response, and ephemeral literal-loopback listener; it has no outbound client and accepts no provider, model, listener, handler, path, command, filesystem, or external-network authority
result.response: each accepted request returns canonical JSON labeled evidenceClass=harness_only and traceClass=scripted_tool_selection with only the fixed recording-tool name and synthetic marker/safe-sink arguments
result.evidence: all accepted, rejected, overflow, and incomplete receipts remain harness-only; only a complete exact request receives canonical safe-header, canonical-body, and complete-response digests
result.secretSafety: the marker, sink URL, header names and values, trailers, canonical request, and exact response are screened for declared and recognized credentials before any content digest
result.bounds: request admission saturates at MaxRequests plus one content-free overflow receipt, bodies read at most MaxRequestBytes plus one byte, responses are package-bounded, and shutdown is idempotent with each caller retaining its own deadline
result.determinism: equivalent requests and fresh same-input instances produce byte-identical scripted responses and digests while private runtime URLs remain distinct
result.isolation: concurrent requests and distinct marker/sink instances retain separate state, monotonic handler-admission sequence, exact response identity, and bounded receipts
result.tests: wrong marker, extra/duplicate fields, query, encoded path, wrong host/method/content type, secret name/value/trailer, oversize, cross-run, concurrency, replay, cancellation, count-25, race count-5, affected-assurance, full CLI, vet, format, and Darwin/Linux/Windows compile-only checks passed
result.independentReview: approved the frozen source/test hashes with no remaining high or medium SE-04-07 blocker and made no workspace or ledger writes

limits: This is a private scripted harness protocol, not a provider or model API and not a Mastra compatibility surface.
It proves deterministic harness conformance only. It does not prove real model behavior, model security, token or cost observations, ALLOW or BLOCK behavior, or project integration.
Receipt sequence is handler admission and processing order, not an independently measured TCP packet-arrival timestamp or model causal trace.
Exact consumption by a project adapter, binding to the generated sink instance, service cleanup correlation, and scenario judgment remain later integration work.
This task used only in-process loopback traffic. It did not launch a project or sandbox, contact a provider, call production OpenBox, use a credential, or write an external control plane.
